subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI. ----PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 139 (AE(PD)-27). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics), TR (transformation) and INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From EXP-DYM: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) and OP-SPD (option spread). From TR: COS-P (cosmic particulars) and PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From INFO-SOLD: STF (source transfer). From ACC-DY: MTH (methodology) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From COS-P: INFO-INTG (information integration). From PHY-U-C: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From STF: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From POL-DYM: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From APP-RDEF: RE-ST (restructuralism) and RE-CONT (recontinuance). From RE-CONT: AF-NT (affinity nature).
